## Pro sign-in works again

Signing in to cmem.ai Pro from the plugin returned a 500 error on every fresh plugin install. The plugin's install did not include `better-auth`, and its tables were never created. The plugin now ships `better-auth` and `@better-auth/api-key` as dependencies and creates the auth tables the first time they are needed (#5455, thanks @0xABCD01).

## Fixes

- **Worker:** when a run pauses after a transport, rate-limit or similar abort, it now releases its claims, so the paused sessio
- **Fresh databases:** My Work lists observation activity again on a newly created database (#5427).
- Restore the server viewer's read endpoints using the server's Postgres data and existing team/project authorization. Shared server log files remain unavailable to tenant keys.
- Context reads keep working when the database's `-wal` and wal-index files are missing. (#5432 by @0xABCD01)

- Docker: the server and worker share the same BullMQ queue prefix, and the docs list tested Redis-compatible servers. The sync-api container runs as a non-root user. (#5389, #5390 by @murtazayusuf, #5331 by @DeryFerd)
- Test fix for macOS SQLite. (#5313 by @patrickballard)

- My Work no longer slows other worker requests on large databases, and saving rules or focus rebuilds the view once instead of twice. (#5284 by @Kirat0201; #5239 by @LucianVane)
- `claude-md:regenerate` reads the database from `CLAUDE_MEM_DATA_DIR`. (#5210 by @Bortlesboat)

## Privacy fix

Browser setup no longer uploads your prompts to cmem.ai without asking. Fixes #5176.

The browser setup opened by `npx claude-mem install` (since v15.2.0) scanned local agent histories and uploaded the full text of the last 30 days of prompts, with session IDs, project names, folder paths and timestamps, without asking.

**What changed (#5220)**

- The scan now reads local history only, then stops and asks. Nothing leaves the machine until you answer.
- A new consent panel states what is sen

## Fixes
- Work view: telemetry volume cuts. High-volume events (observer turns, work-state use, context injections, searches, skills) are now one daily rollup per install with a `count`; worker start/stop carry `restart_count`; failures are one event per type per day with `count`.
- Observer: after a spent cmem.ai allowance, the gateway is probed once a day instead of on every resume.
- Work view: fixed a runaway "opened" event; hosted viewer reports analytics with `viewer_host='hosted'`.
- Work view: idle

Repository cleanup. No changes to how claude-mem runs.

- The repo root drops from 60 entries to 36, so the README sits much higher on the GitHub page.
- Old plans, reports, playbooks and generated files are gone, along with the superseded `cursor-hooks/` and `ragtime/` directories.
- Docs, test assets and Docker files moved into `docs/`, `tests/`, `.github/`, `.claude/` and `docker/`. The changelog now lives at `docs/CHANGELOG.md`, and the security policy at `.github/SECURITY.md`.
- The Cloudflare sync hub

## What's Changed
* feat(viewer): cloud viewer host for My Work, and work_state sync for every account by @thedotmack in https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/pull/5193


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.7.0...v15.8.0

- **Node.js 18** is supported again: `engines` is `>=18` and CI runs it. Nothing in Postgres.js needs 20; `using`, `await using` and tracing are used where the runtime has them. Loading it with `require` still needs Node.js 20.19 or 22.12.
- **`PGSSLMODE` is read** (#1307). It was ignored, so `PGSSLMODE=verify-full` connected in plain text without an error. This may change how existing setups connect: `require` now uses TLS and fails against a server without it, and `verify-ca` and `verify-full` check the c

- **A NUL character in a connection parameter can no longer add parameters** (also in v3). A `database`, `user` or `connection` value such as `'db\0user\0postgres'` was sent as further startup parameters, so an app that put untrusted input there, as with a database per tenant, could be made to log in as another user where that user needs no password, or with `replication` or `options` set. A NUL in any protocol string, also in query text and identifiers, now rejects with `NUL_CHARACTER`.
- **TypeScript:** t

- Fix https://github.com/porsager/postgres/issues/1143  1e92809

# Version 1.1.0 revision notes

This additive post-acquisition supplement publishes 32 earlier unpublished supporting syscall trials within the same study. Their 28 September 2026 collection dates and four separate eight-trial denominators are explicit. They remain pilot evidence, never pooled with the registered campaign.

The manuscript now states acquisition timestamps relative to registration, maps each family to its acquisition filesystem, highlights the 0/40 ACK-marker dependent-prefix result and the

The complete evidence ZIP contains 930 assignments, 929 result records and 925 eligible endpoint oracles. The four unknown endpoints and one premeasurement slot remain preserved. Original scientific records were copied byte-for-byte, and all 95 cells and 43 registered comparisons were independently recomputed before publication. Prior pilots, qualification observations, full disk images, credentials and private transfer maps are excluded. Dependent log-prefix reconstructions add zero scientific units.
